literal: Staying in one's own home, sharing one's own food and eating, is like the embrace of this beautiful, golden-complexioned young woman.
translation: The embrace of this beautiful, golden-complexioned young woman is like staying in one's own home and eating one's food after sharing it with others.
modern: தன் சொந்த வீட்டில் இருந்து, தன் உணவைப் பிறருடன் பகிர்ந்து உண்பதைப் போன்றது, அழகிய மாமை நிறமுடைய இப்பெண்ணின் தழுவல்.
explanation: This couplet compares the joy of the beloved's embrace to the ultimate domestic happiness. Living in one's own home and sharing one's food with others before eating represents the pinnacle of virtuous householder life. The poet suggests that the embrace of the beautiful, golden-complexioned young woman yields the same deep, wholesome, and guilt-free satisfaction. The word 'மா' refers to the beautiful mango-shoot-like golden complexion of the woman, which is highly praised in classical Tamil poetry.
